title: Q10
description:
“Who makes His angels spirits and His ministers a flame of fire.”
Read: Psa 104:1–4
a) In Psa 104 this line sits in a list of what Yahweh *makes and uses*: light, the heavens, clouds, wind. (The Hebrew word can mean either “angels” or “messengers,” and either “spirits” or “winds.”) What does that setting bring forward about angels?
b) Set this beside 1:8: “But to the Son He says, ‘Your throne, O God…’” What contrast does Psa 104 let Hebrews draw that it could not draw by simply saying angels are lesser?
